sections.name: Physics
sections.questions_weightage: 30 Questions (Section A: 20 MCQs, Section B: 10 Numerical Qs attempt 5) / 100 Marks
sections.scope: Physics and Measurement, Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work Energy and Power, Rotational Motion, Gravitation, Properties of Solids and Liquids, Thermodynamics, Kinetic Theory of Gases, Oscillations and Waves, Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism, Electromagnetic Induction and Alternating Currents, Electromagnetic Waves, Optics, Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation, Atoms and Nuclei, Electronic Devices.

sections.name: Chemistry
sections.questions_weightage: 30 Questions (Section A: 20 MCQs, Section B: 10 Numerical Qs attempt 5) / 100 Marks
sections.scope: Physical Chemistry: Some Basic Concepts in Chemistry, Atomic Structure, Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure, Chemical Thermodynamics, Solutions, Equilibrium, Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry, Chemical Kinetics. Inorganic Chemistry: Classification of Elements and Periodicity, p-Block Elements (Groups 13-18), d- and f-Block Elements, Coordination Compounds. Organic Chemistry: Purification and Characterization of Organic Compounds, Some Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry (GOC), Hydrocarbons, Organic Compounds Containing Halogens, Oxygen, and Nitrogen, Biomolecules, Principles Related to Practical Chemistry.

sections.name: Mathematics
sections.questions_weightage: 30 Questions (Section A: 20 MCQs, Section B: 10 Numerical Qs attempt 5) / 100 Marks
sections.scope: Sets Relations and Functions, Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations, Matrices and Determinants, Permutations and Combinations, Binomial Theorem, Sequences and Series, Limit Continuity and Differentiability, Integral Calculus (Definite and Indefinite), Differential Equations, Coordinate Geometry (Straight Lines, Circles, Conic Sections: Parabola, Ellipse, Hyperbola), Three Dimensional Geometry, Vector Algebra, Statistics and Probability, Trigonometry.

subjects.name: Physics (भौतिक विज्ञान)
domains: Physics and Measurement: Dimensions, Significant figures, Units, Vernier caliper, Screw gauge
Kinematics: Rectilinear motion, Projectile motion, Relative velocity, Uniform and non-uniform circular motion
Laws of Motion: Newton laws, Impulse, Momentum conservation, Friction (static, kinetic, rolling), Centripetal force
Work, Energy and Power: Work-energy theorem, Conservative forces, Potential energy curves, Elastic and inelastic collisions
Rotational Motion: Center of mass, Moment of inertia, Parallel and perpendicular axis theorems, Torque, Angular momentum conservation, Rolling motion
Gravitation: Kepler laws, Universal gravitational law, Gravitational potential and field, Orbital and escape velocity, Satellite motion
Properties of Solids and Liquids: Hooke law, Youngs bulk shear moduli, Streamline and turbulent flow, Viscosity, Stokes law, Terminal velocity, Surface tension, Capillarity
Thermodynamics & Kinetic Theory: Zeroth, First and Second laws, Isothermal and adiabatic processes, Heat engines, Carnot cycle, Ideal gas equation, RMS speed, Degrees of freedom, Law of equipartition
Oscillations and Waves: SHM equations, Energy in SHM, Simple and physical pendulum, Forced oscillations and resonance, Wave equation, Superposition, Beats, Doppler effect
Electrostatics: Coulomb law, Electric field and potential, Gauss law and applications, Capacitors in series and parallel, Energy stored in capacitor, Dielectrics
Current Electricity: Ohm law, Drift velocity, Temperature coefficient of resistance, Kirchhoff laws, Wheatstone bridge, Metre bridge, Potentiometer
Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism: Biot-Savart law, Ampere circuital law, Force on current carrying wire, Galvanometer to ammeter/voltmeter conversion, Magnetic dip, Hysteresis
Electromagnetic Induction & AC: Faraday law, Lenz law, Self and mutual inductance, AC circuits (LCR series), Resonance, Q-factor, Power factor, AC generator and transformer
Optics: Reflection and refraction at spherical surfaces, Lens maker formula, Total internal reflection, Optical instruments, Huygens principle, Interference (YDSE), Diffraction, Polarization

Dual Nature, Atoms, Nuclei & Electronics: Photoelectric effect, de Broglie relation, Rutherford and Bohr models, Mass defect and binding energy, Nuclear fission and fusion, p-n junction diode, LEDs, Photodiodes, Solar cells, Zener diode, Logic gates

subjects.name: Chemistry (रसायन विज्ञान)
domains: Some Basic Concepts in Chemistry: Mole concept, Molar mass, Percentage composition, Empirical and molecular formula, Stoichiometry, Limiting reagent
Atomic Structure: Bohr model, Dual nature of matter, Heisenberg uncertainty principle, Quantum numbers, Aufbau principle, Pauli exclusion principle, Hund rule
Chemical Bonding & Molecular Structure: Ionic and covalent bonding, VSEPR theory, Hybridization (sp, sp2, sp3, dsp2, sp3d2), Molecular orbital theory, Hydrogen bonding
Chemical Thermodynamics: System and surroundings, State functions, First law, Enthalpy, Heat capacity, Hess law, Second law, Entropy, Gibbs energy and spontaneity criteria
Solutions: Concentration units (Molarity, Molality, Mole fraction), Raoult law, Ideal and non-ideal solutions, Colligative properties, van t Hoff factor
Equilibrium: Chemical equilibrium constant, Le Chatelier principle, Ionic equilibrium, Ostwald dilution law, pH, Buffer solutions, Solubility product (Ksp)
Redox Reactions & Electrochemistry: Oxidation numbers, Balancing redox reactions, Galvanic cells, Nernst equation, Conductance, Kohlrausch law, Faraday laws of electrolysis
Chemical Kinetics: Rate of reaction, Order and molecularity, Zero and first order integrated rate laws, Half-life, Arrhenius equation, Activation energy, Catalysis
Inorganic Chemistry - Classification & Periodic Properties: Modern periodic table, Trends in atomic radius, Ionization enthalpy, Electron gain enthalpy, Electronegativity
Inorganic Chemistry - p-Block Elements: Group 13 to 18 properties, Allotropes of carbon, Boranes, Silicones, Nitric acid, Phosphoric acid, Oxoacids of sulphur and halogens
Inorganic Chemistry - d- and f-Block Elements: Transition metal configurations, Variable oxidation states, Catalytic properties, Magnetic properties, Lanthanoid contraction
Inorganic Chemistry - Coordination Compounds: Werner theory, IUPAC nomenclature, Valence bond theory, Crystal field theory (CFSE, high spin/low spin), Isomerism
Organic Chemistry - GOC & Purification: Inductive, Resonance, Hyperconjugation effects, Electrophiles, Nucleophiles, Carbocations, Carbanions, Free radicals stability
Organic Chemistry - Hydrocarbons: Alkanes (free radical halogenation), Alkenes (Markovnikov and anti-Markovnikov additions, ozonolysis), Alkynes (acidity, additions), Aromaticity

Organic Functional Groups: Alkyl halides (SN1 and SN2 mechanisms), Alcohols (Lucas test, oxidation), Phenols (Kolbe, Reimer-Tiemann), Ethers (cleavage by HI), Aldehydes and Ketones (Nucleophilic addition, Aldol, Cannizzaro, Clemmensen, Wolff-Kishner), Carboxylic acids, Amines (Hoffmann bromamide, Carbylamine, Diazonium coupling), Biomolecules (Carbohydrates, Amino acids, Peptide bond, Nucleic acids)

subjects.name: Mathematics (गणित)
domains: Sets, Relations and Functions: Types of relations (equivalence), Domain and range, One-one, onto and invertible functions, Composite functions
Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations: Modulus and argument, Complex conjugate, Triangle inequality, Roots of quadratic equations, Relation between roots and coefficients
Matrices and Determinants: Matrix operations, Transpose, Symmetric and skew-symmetric, Invertible matrices, Determinant properties, Adjoint, Cramer rule, System of linear equations
Permutations and Combinations: Fundamental counting principles, Permutations, Combinations, Circular permutations, Division into groups, Combinatorial identities
Binomial Theorem & Sequences: Binomial expansion for positive integral index, General and middle terms, Greatest term, AP, GP, Sum to n terms, AM-GM inequality, Arithmetic-geometric progressions
Limit, Continuity and Differentiability: Evaluation of limits (L Hospital rule, standard limits), Continuity at a point and interval, Differentiability, Chain rule, Implicit differentiation
Applications of Derivatives: Tangents and normals, Rate of change, Monotonicity (increasing/decreasing), Maxima and minima, Rolle and Mean Value Theorems
Indefinite and Definite Integrals: Standard integrals, Integration by substitution, by parts, partial fractions, Fundamental theorem of calculus, Properties of definite integrals, Leibniz rule
Applications of Integrals: Area bounded by simple curves, Area between intersecting parabolas, circles, and straight lines

Differential Equations: Order and degree, Formation of differential equations, Variable separable method, Homogeneous differential equations, First-order linear differential equations (Integrating factor)
Coordinate Geometry - Straight Lines: Slope, Various forms of equations of line, Angle between lines, Distance of a point from a line, Family of lines, Concurrent lines
Coordinate Geometry - Circles: Standard and general equation, Tangent and normal, Parametric equations, Chord of contact, Intersection of circles, Orthogonal circles
Coordinate Geometry - Conic Sections: Parabola (standard forms, focal chord, tangent), Ellipse (eccentricity, foci, directrices, tangent), Hyperbola (asymptotes, rectangular hyperbola)
Three Dimensional Geometry: Direction cosines and direction ratios, Equation of a line in 3D, Shortest distance between skew lines, Angle between lines

Vector Algebra, Statistics & Probability: Vectors (dot and cross products, scalar triple product), Measures of dispersion (variance and standard deviation), Classical and axiomatic probability, Conditional probability, Bayes theorem, Independent events
